svg.title: Gabriele Monni | Software engineer
svg.desc: Neofetch-style card with an ASCII portrait of Gabriele Monni. Role: Software engineer. Work: IT Technical Officer. Study: MSc Computer Science, Applied AI. Base: Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy. Code: Python, TypeScript, Swift, SQL. Stack: React, SwiftUI, MLX, llama.cpp. Speaks: Italian, English. Web: gabrielemonni.me. Applied AI, native products and data systems, from a defensible idea to software people use. Projects. WhisperDrop: Local transcription and dictation for Mac; AgentFiles: Menu bar app that syncs AI instruction files; DwarfStar: Qwen 27B running locally on 16 GB Macs; MUVAD: Video anomaly detection that explains itself; AI Capability Signals: Data story on what AI can do and what it costs; Video Edit Checker: Catches video editing mistakes with local AI. Focus radar with values Gabriele chose, out of 100: Local AI 92; Data analysis 80; Native apps 72; Automation 82; AI research 77; Multimodal AI 88.
